style_details.primary_style: Medieval illuminated manuscript art with flat perspective, stylized figures. Scenes resemble hand-painted pages from a codex, blending sacred and profane imagery.
influences: The Romance of the Rose illustrations
style_details.technique: Egg tempera and mineral pigments on parchment, with flat planes of color, fine linework, and gilded highlights. Decorative borders and symbolic motifs are woven around the main scene.
style_details.lighting: Even, icon-like illumination with minimal shadows. Gold leaf and bright pigment highlights create contrast rather than naturalistic lighting.
style_details.palette: Deep ultramarine blues, rich reds, earthy ochres, gold accents, and ivory parchment backgrounds. Colorful but flat, with bold contrasts.
style_details.mood: Secretive, playful, and slightly subversive. Evokes both the reverence of sacred texts and the hidden intimacy of medieval erotic imagination. A blend of taboo curiosity and historical authenticity.
